correctness.rationale: For every k>=2,m>=1,B,t>0 and N=k+m+1, effective-resistance objective is strictly convex over individually controlled connected simple-graph edge weights, so graph automorphisms force unique orbit values a on k hub/core spokes, b on m pendant bridges, c on nonhub clique chords. Core eigenmodes and pendant bridge series law yield exact Kirchhoff index K=m(N-1)/b+(m+1)/a+(k-1)N/(a+kc); independent rational grounded-Laplacian check for k=2,m=1,a=b=1/4,c=1/5 gives matrix K=340/13 matching formula. Budget B=ka+mb+[t k(k-1)/2]c. With v=a+kc>=a, alpha=k-t(k-1)/2, beta=t(k-1)/2, Cauchy–Schwarz lower bound is attained by positive c exactly when t<tau_N=2N/(N-1), yielding explicit b*=B sqrt(N-1)/Z,a*=B sqrt((m+1)/alpha)/Z,c*=B/kZ[ sqrt((k-1)N/beta)-sqrt((m+1)/alpha) ],K*=Z²/B. For t>=tau_N, chord-free star a=b=B/(N-1) satisfies every chord KKT inequality, unique by strict convexity, K*=(N-1)^3/B. Fixed m asymptotic ratio min(t/2,1) follows from dominant O(k^(3/2)) normalization. Independent small k,m optimization budgets and signs checked.
